variants.prompt:

Very thick slightly wobbly BLACK outlines, simple flat RED and GOLDEN-YELLOW clothes, warm peach skin, clean WHITE background. No 3D, realistic textures, dense detailing or elaborate painting. Keep the same overall cute family as the approved male portraits, while clearly designing a female hairstyle.

Composition: square 1:1 BUST / upper body, show entire hair ornament/buns and both hands/prop with comfortable margins. ONE person, no full-body legs, no collage or scenery, no lettering/rank name/watermark. No OK gesture. No sect-specific symbols; the portrait represents rank only.

MANDATORY: put ONE SMALL GOLDEN McDonald's Golden Arches double-arch M on a RED area of her left chest (viewer right), same discreet polo-shirt embroidery scale as Image 1, about 5–7% of torso clothing width. It must be recognizable and unobscured, not huge, not a typed block M, not omitted, not hidden by hair/props/ribbons. Keep ornaments red and gold rather than the hair references' green or purple.

Specific female rank design: A new female visitor with TWO SMALL ROUND SIDE BUNS tied with simple yellow ribbon bows, short soft uneven bangs and two tiny side locks. The simplest, most modest costume.
